description: The Ex-Lap App is a smartphone-based learning and management application developed with BoYi Times Medical Technology for the STALS laparoscopic training course.
title: Ex-Lap App

description: A 52-item, 5-point Likert parent-report assessment adapted into Arabic to measure cool and hot executive-function domains in children aged 7–9.
title: Executive Functioning Scale (EFS), Arabic-adapted parent-report instrument

description: A publicly available dataset from Funayama et al.
title: Expanded RIKEN SAS dataset with 10,000 new annotations

description: A whole-school educational model developed and supported by EL Education that organizes schools around experiential, project-based learning and related schoolwide practices.
title: Expeditionary Learning

description: Experience Corps is a community-based programme that places adults aged 55 and older in elementary schools to tutor and mentor at-risk students, assist teachers, and lead enrichment activities.
title: Experience Corps

description: A software scaffold integrated into an online inquiry-learning environment that guides learners through designing, conducting, and analyzing virtual experiments; developed by Siswa van Riesen et al.
title: Experiment Design Tool (EDT)

description: Yang et al.'s dataset contains 207 medical-student clinical history-taking sessions and 4,815 human–AI dialogue turns annotated by clinical experts for message fidelity, dialogue intent, scaffolding need, and OSCE performance.
title: Expert-annotated clinical consultation corpus of 207 sessions and 4,815 messages with four annotation dimensions

description: A corpus of approximately 1,954 Hungarian reflective essays from Early Childhood Education students, expert-annotated on a four-level reflection scale by Zsolt Csibi and colleagues.
title: Expert-annotated Hungarian reflective essay dataset

description: A study-developed scenario-based assessment and training instrument for trainee radiographers and medical-imaging practitioners to select empathic responses when explaining MRI procedures to anxious patients.
title: Expert-panel-scored MRI empathic communication scenario tool with nine scaffolded steps and 1–3 response scoring

description: An expert-designed assessment suite of natural-language GUI-oriented vibe-coding tasks with predefined scoring criteria and rubrics, developed by the article's international subject-matter-expert panel for tertiary students.
title: Expert-vetted assessment suite of GUI-oriented vibe-coding tasks with scoring criteria

description: The Expository Reading and Writing Course is a college-preparatory English language arts curriculum developed by the California State University system for secondary students, with modules that integrate rhetorical reading, writing, revision, and language study.
title: Expository Reading and Writing Course (ERWC)

description: A computer-based Stroop/Day-Night-adapted assessment for early primary school children that measures inhibitory control through 36 rule-reversal color-naming trials scored by accuracy.
title: Extended 36-trial Red-Blue Test

description: A manualized group intervention for children and adolescents with behavioural problems that combines social-skills training, anger-control training, and moral-reasoning or character-education training, delivered by trained ART facilitators.
title: Extended Aggression Replacement Training (ART) programme

description: A dataset released by Josmario Albuquerque and colleagues containing 345 contextualized OER sentences annotated by 193 higher-education students for perceived ethnic bias, with contextual metadata, aggregate labels, bias scores, and reproducibility code.
title: Extended labelled dataset of 345 OER sentences with ethnic-bias annotations from 193 students

description: The XRPS is a 17-item Likert survey developed and validated by Gandolfi et al.
title: eXtended Reality Presence Scale (XRPS)

description: A dataset of video-recorded and transcribed project meetings from two interdisciplinary higher-education e-learning course-design teams, compiled by Rapanta et al.
title: Extended verbal protocol dataset of 15 e-learning design team meetings

description: ERST is an adaptive educational system developed to individualise and support learners' choices among information visualisations during reasoning tasks.
title: External Representation Selection Tutor (ERST)
